# Bundled map libraries

The browser map dependencies are pinned and served locally so a slow or blocked
third-party CDN cannot delay the empty map shell.

- Leaflet 1.9.4 — BSD-2-Clause (`leaflet/LICENSE`)
- Leaflet.markercluster 1.5.3 — MIT (`markercluster/LICENSE`)
- Leaflet.heat 0.2.0 — BSD-2-Clause (`leaflet-heat/LICENSE`)

These are unmodified distribution files. The map data and tiles are still
provided by the separately attributed configured map provider.
